messages:
devon: heads-up — cu12 canary in us-west-1 started flapping ~15:03 UTC, 4/12 canary nodes failing during model load. containers killed, NCCL hangs. logs attached below.
alesha: paste the exact failing lines? single instance type or mixed?
devon: all g5.8x nodes, different racks. snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T15:03:12Z] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 00000000000000a8
[2026-03-12T15:03:12Z] nvidia: probe of nvidia0 failed with error -22
[2026-03-12T15:03:13Z] modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.101-rt
[2026-03-12T15:03:14Z] nccl: Allreduce: timeout waiting for rank 0
[2026-03-12T15:03:15Z] containerd: oom-kill: container \"model-server\" pid=4512 exe=\"/usr/bin/python\"
```
samir: modprobe not found + kernel NULL pointer -> smells like mismatched kmod/soname or broken initramfs. did we change kernel on these hosts recently?
devon: yes, we rolled security kernel 5.15.95 -> 5.15.101 last night via rolling updates. most hosts fine, but these 4 started failing with cu12 image.
maya: were those nodes using the new image-builder templates or older AMIs?
devon: they came up from image-builder v3 images (date 2026-03-08). suspect race where driver userland and kmod diverged at build time.
ops-bot: Deploy canary: cu12-toolkit -> 12 nodes in us-west-1; status: failing (4/12). Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canaries/2799991111
ron: can we repro single-node locally? if it's initramfs issue, a chroot/regenerate might fix but AMI fix needed.
devon: repro steps I ran on a quarantined node:
1) pull cu12 container
2) apt install nvidia-driver-535 (vendor package)
3) start model-server -> immediate crash at nvml init
modinfo shows /lib/modules/5.15.101-rt/extra/nvidia.ko present but version string mismatches libnvidia.so.
alesha: that confirms packaging mismatch. maybe image-builder cached older kmod and later driver package upgraded. we need to make build deterministic: install driver and then run depmod/update-initramfs.
samir: blast radius if we continue? rollout would touch ~1800 GPU nodes. hold recommended.
maya: confirming — hold rollout now and tag canary as blocked. I'll set rollout_hold.
devon: mitigation plan proposal:
- pause cu12 rollout (done)
- quarantine failing nodes and drain
- attempt manual modprobe rebuild + update-initramfs on isolated hosts to see if recovery possible without reprovision
- add a determinism gate to image-builder: lock driver package version and run depmod+update-initramfs and manifest checksums
- rebuild AMI and run a tight 3-node canary with checksum validation before resuming
ron: add routing fallback: steer heavy jobs to cu11 pool for 48h to buy time. be warned about cost delta; cu11 pool utilization is high.
ops-bot: Routing ticket #INC-2026-494 created: fallback cu12 -> cu11 for high-memory inference. assignee: ron
alex: pinging NVIDIA engineering — can we get quick eyes on the soname mismatch? may also be caused by different DKMS builds on kernel vs vendor package.
vendor-bot: NVIDIA ticket NV-76422 opened referencing logs. contact: eng-support@nvidia.com
devon: dug into AMI artifact lists: image-builder v3 had a post-install step that skipped update-initramfs due to a transient error. that explains stale modules in /lib/modules.
alesha: add CI smoke: after image build, boot a tiny VM and run modinfo + small NCCL allreduce smoke test to catch this early.
samir: can we pin driver to prior stable 535.20 as a short-term rollback for canary?
devon: we can, but that delays security fixes. prefer AMI rebuild first and use pin if rebuild overruns SLA.
maya: I'll add an artifact manifest export to S3 and a diff tool to compare kmod checksums across builds, so bisection is easier next time.
ron: ETA for AMI rebuild + validation: 8-12 hours for dev image, 24h for stable catalogs + constrained canary. I'll update incident doc with timeline.
devon: manual attempt: on one quarantined host I ran apt-get remove nvidia-driver; reinstalled matching package; ran depmod -a && update-initramfs -u; modprobe nvidia succeeded; restarted model-server and it recovered. so manual recover works.
alesha: good repro and manual fix — still need pipeline fix. annotate canary job with hold-reason: kmod-stale, so automation won't retry.
devon: done. canary flagged and autoremoval disabled.
alex: vendor looking at whether 535.x has tighter kernel symbol requirements on RT kernels. will report.
infra-bot: Incident updated: cu12 canary hold. Severity: P2. Links: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-494
samir: one more: ensure image-builder records the exact kernel version and kernel-headers package and include their hashes in the manifest. helps with reproducibility.
maya: agreed. creating infra task now.
devon: thanks everyone — will post follow-up after AMI rebuild smoke passes.
